heroCommands.command:
pip install serviette
export PATHWAY_LICENSE_KEY=...
export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
serviette demo --embedder openai

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: serviette is a no-code RAG server built on the Pathway framework. Point it at a folder of documents, choose a vector database and an embedder in one YAML file, and you get a chat page and a REST API that answer from those documents with cited sources.
sixtySeconds.problem: Most document Q&A setups go stale: someone has to re-upload or re-index files after every change. serviette watches your sources and reflects edits, new files and deletions in its answers within seconds.
whoFor: Teams that want Q&A over internal documents
Developers who need a RAG API without writing pipeline code
Organisations that want data to stay on their own machines
Users of pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus and other vector databases
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an always-up-to-date RAG server configured in one YAML file, with eight vector database backends and a fully local option using local embeddings and DuckDB.
requirements: An LLM API key for answer text (optional with a local stack)

overview: serviette runs two processes, an indexer and a stateless API server, that share only the vector database. DuckDB is the default zero-setup backend; pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Pinecone and MongoDB Atlas are also supported.

Sources can be local folders, Google Drive, S3 or MinIO, SharePoint and anything PyFilesystem opens, such as FTP or SFTP. It parses text, Office files, PDFs with tables, scanned images, and with API keys, audio and video. Embedders include OpenAI, LiteLLM, SentenceTransformers, Gemini and Bedrock.

The server hosts a chat page on / next to the versioned API at /api/v1. A serviette wizard command can generate the YAML config. It needs a free Pathway license key from pathway.com. The repository is MIT licensed, and the older llm-app templates now live in the Pathway repository.

steps.title: Set your keys
steps.body: Get a free Pathway license at pathway.com/framework/get-license.

environment.name: PATHWAY_LICENSE_KEY
environment.description: Free Pathway license key, required by every command.

environment.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environment.description: Needed when you use OpenAI for embeddings or answers.

firstRun.title: Run the demo
firstRun.body: It indexes a small bundled corpus into ./serviette-demo/docs and opens a chat at http://localhost:8989.

tutorial.title: Watch answers change as you edit a document
tutorial.useCase: Run the demo, ask a question, edit a file and ask again.

steps.title: Ask a question in the chat
steps.body: Open http://localhost:8989 and ask about the bundled coffee-machine company docs.

steps.title: Edit or add a file
steps.body: Change a file in ./serviette-demo/docs while it runs, then ask again.

tutorial.expected: Within seconds the answer reflects your edit and cites the changed document.
